text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove a designated on-street accessible loading zone, on the west side of Shaw Street, south of Bloor Street West. The accessible permit holder who originally requested the loading zone has passed away and the space is no longer required.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone that operates from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Shaw Street, between a point 106.8 metres south of Bloor Street West and a point 6 metres further south.
